QuerySandboxes.limit: Number of items per page, range 1-100; 0 or omitted defaults to 100; out-of-range returns 400.
QuerySandboxes.nextToken: Pagination cursor; use the nextToken from the previous page's response; omit for the first page.
QuerySandboxes.sandboxIds: List of sandbox instance IDs, up to 100, must not contain empty strings.
QuerySandboxes.imagePaths: List of actual sandbox image paths, up to 100, must not contain empty strings.
QuerySandboxes.metadata: Metadata filter; the sandbox must contain all key-value pairs.
QuerySandboxes.state: State filter; one of running, paused, pending, standby, failed, killing, killed; omit to not filter by state; other values return 400.
